As the Admin AI Assistant for El-Narges Compound, I can help you perform the following administrative tasks:
1. Change User Roles: Promote or downgrade registered users to roles such as owner, broker, engineer, admin, or regular user.
2. Assign Units: Assign specific unit numbers or properties to users, owners, or brokers.
3. Bulk Price Updates: Update property prices in bulk based on their model type (e.g., ModelU, ModelX, StandAlone, TwinHouse) and property category (apartment or villa).

Feel free to issue any commands related to these capabilities!
